name: VibeKode Berlin 2026
description: AI coding and agentic development conference, part of AI Native Week
note: on-site or remote livestream; German and English; conference days 18-19 Nov; co-located with MLcon Berlin
details:
VibeKode is the Software & Support Media conference on AI-assisted software development, with four tracks: AI Coding, Agentic Development, AI-Driven Software Delivery and AI-Native Teams.

Bootcamps run 16-17 Nov, workshops 17 and 20 Nov, conference and expo 18-19 Nov. It is part of AI Native Week together with MLcon, AI Engineering Summit and API Conference at the same venue. Cheapest ticket: workshop day from 659 EUR (incl. 10% team discount, plus VAT); 2-day pass from 1,079 EUR. Remote tickets include a livestream with live Q&A.
